claims.hypothesis: Does the MM1 disk have a central mass as large as earlier estimates (~40 Msun)?

evidence.quote: Keplerian fitting of the molecular data associated with the disk gives a central source mass of 20 $M_{\odot}$, which is about two times lower than the previous estimates for MM1a

claims.hypothesis: Does the disk show one kinematic regime across all radii?

claims.finding: Two distinct velocity fields exist in the disk

evidence.quote: (1) Keplerian rotation at radii of $<$300 au, traced by high-velocity CH$_3$CN emission, and (2) sub-Keplerian rotation at larger disk radii, $>$300 au, traced by mid-velocity CH$_3$CN emission

claims.hypothesis: Is MM1b a fragment of the MM1a disk?

claims.finding: MM1b appears to be a distinct source rather than a disk fragment

evidence.quote: The source MM1b appears to be a distinct source rather than a disk fragment as no molecular emission associated with MM1b and no connection between MM1a and MM1b are detected.

referee_caveats_inferred: Central mass depends strongly on whether CH3OH is included (20 vs ~35 Msun), so the factor-of-two reduction is tracer dependent
Launching radius rests on an assumed outflow velocity (30 vs 100 km/s) and an uncorrected 15 Msun mass, spanning 10-100 au
No fit uncertainties or sampler are given for the Keplerian fits
Specific angular momentum values differ between main text (4500, 1600) and Conclusions (4720, 1420)
Emission lines are mostly single lines for SO and SO2, so excitation and opacity are unconstrained
Spectra taken at one offset position are used to characterise the whole disk

reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: One 1.5 hr Band 6 execution with five 960-channel spectral windows at 28 mas resolution; likely tens to a few hundred GB of raw/calibrated data, cubes at ~mas pixels several GB each
reproducibility.score_reason: Single ALMA project code is given and the numeric results are listed, but imaging parameters, continuum subtraction, SLIM setup and Keplerian fit details are missing, and several steps rest on inherited methods.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: The paper does not state data availability, and the recipe leaves out imaging, line-free channels and fit settings, so an independent redo would require many unstated choices.
